keyword: what time do the masters start today
claims: Final-round play for the 2026 Masters begins Sunday.
Tee times for the final round of the 2026 Masters start around 11:00 a.m. ET.
The final pairing of Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
Live television coverage on CBS runs from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Streaming is available on Paramount+, the ESPN App, and Masters.com.
Featured Groups start at 10:15 a.m. ET.
